bullets.text: T-Mobile's Legal Troubles Escalate - **Verizon** challenges T-Mobile's switching strategy, claiming misleading savings and deceptive practices.
AT&T Partners with Amazon - **AT&T** integrates **Amazon Leo** satellite service with its fiber network for enhanced connectivity.
Debunking Open RAN Myths - **Wind River** asserts that Open RAN technology is now mature and scalable for diverse deployments.
Bell's AI Revenue Soars - **Bell Canada** reports a 60% year-over-year growth in its AI-powered enterprise solutions.
5G Slicing Validated - **Ericsson**, **FET**, and **OPPO** confirm performance-based 5G slicing can enhance connectivity.
Amazon Leo Launch Delayed - **Amazon** requests a two-year extension for its satellite launch, facing execution hurdles.
Quantum Security Threats Loom - Experts warn of impending quantum technology capable of breaking current encryption by the 2030s.
Verizon's AI Infrastructure Strategy - **Verizon** outlines plans for dense fiber and private 5G to support enterprise AI workloads.
Network Digital Twins Enhance Operations - New software technology provides real-time insights for telecom networks, improving resilience.
AT&T Expands Fiber Network - **AT&T** completes acquisition of **Lumen's** fiber business, boosting its customer base significantly.
